text: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Property Standards Committee. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Property Standards Committee: PSC2-81 PSC2-122 PSC2-112 PSC2-125 PSC2-140 PSC2-144 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (May 25, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
